import torch

SHAPES = [
    (1,),
    (64, 64),
    (4096, 4096),
    (64, 256, 256),
    (16, 128, 64, 32),
]

def gen_inputs(axes, device):
    idx = axes.get("shape_id", 0)
    shape = SHAPES[idx]
    return {
        "input_0": torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
        "input_1": torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
    }

def run(input_0, input_1, output):
    result = torch.add(input_0, input_1)
    output.copy_(result)
